data.answer: Al Furjan in Dubai is a newly developed gated community by Nakheel Properties, offering a private and secure living environment ideal for families, away from the bustling central region. The community boasts two centers, Al Furjan Pavilion and Al Furjan Club, which provide an array of amenities, including swimming pools, sports courts, restaurants, cafes, and retail outlets. This rapidly growing area is regarded as one of the best places for Indian expatriates to rent properties in Dubai.

The Al Furjan area boasts a fully integrated community featuring villas, apartments, and hotels developed by many of Dubai’s reputable developers. Its thoughtful urban planning, characterized by distinctive and functional features, caters to every aspect of family living. Most of the properties in the area are by Azizi Developers. There’s a wide range of property options for anyone looking for the best communities to invest in Al Furjan.

With its array of amenities, retail facilities, and advantageous proximity to public transportation, Al Furjan stands out as a favored option for both tenants and buyers. Renowned for its accessibility, Furjan ranks among the premier locations for renting apartments near Dubai metro stations. Popular projects like Yasmina Residence, Orchid by Azizi, and Masakin Al Furjan are situated within a 10 km radius of the metro station.

Off-Plan Projects in Al Furjan

There are various off-plan projects in Al Furjan that you need to know about.

Trussardi Residences by Mira Development is a modern building featuring 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, and exclusive 2-bedroom apartments with private pools.

Gemz at Al Furjan
GEMZ by Danube is a new off-plan project in Al Furjan. The tower features studios, 1-3 bedroom apartments, and 2- and 3-bedroom duplexes.

Murooj features 4 and 5-bedroom villas in the Murooj Al Furjan. It is located within walking distance of Al Furjan Metro Station.

Samana California at Al Furjan
Samana California by Samana Developers is an upcoming project in Al Furjan. It features studio to 2-bedroom apartments.

Tilal Al Furjan 
Tilal Al Furjan is a project by Nakheel Developers. You can choose from the 4 and 5-bedroom independent villas in the community of Tilal Al Furjan.

Renting a Property in Al Furjan Dubai

Several sought-after locations within Al Furjan include renowned properties such as Al Furjan West, Quortaj, Azizi Plaza, Azizi Star, and Ice Residence. You can find various rental properties in the community, from Al Furjan studio for rent to Al Furjan villas for rent. You can talk to our experts about the Al Furjan rental properties.

The minimum rent for Al Furjan studio for rent is AED 39.9k, while for 1-bedroom apartments, rental rates start at AED 49k. A 2-bedroom apartment for rent is available for a minimum AED 80k and a 3-bedroom apartment can be rented out for AED 110k.

The rent for 4-bedroom villas starts at AED 185k per annum, while spacious 6-bedroom villas command rental prices starting at AED 300k. Rentals for 4-bedroom townhouses in Al Furjan is AED 170k, while 5-bedroom townhouses can be rented for AED 220k.

Similarly, rental prices for 3-bedroom townhouses in Al Furjan are at least AED 185k, whereas  4-bedroom townhouses are priced at AED 310k.

Al Furjan Properties for Sale

Are you looking for Al Furjan properties for sale? Studios in Al Furjan are available for sale at prices ranging from AED 440k, while 1-bedroom apartments in the same area is available for AED 680k.

Meanwhile, a 3-bedroom villa in Al Furjan is available for AED 2.7M and a 4-bedroom house can be purchased for AED 2.9 M. Townhouses are also available for sale in Al Furjan. You can find a 4-bedroom townhouse for a minimum price of AED 2.7M and you can have to pay at least AED 3.9M for a 5-bedroom townhouse in the area.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Furjan?

data.answer:
Life in Al Furjan offers a vibrant community lifestyle ideal for families and individuals alike. This well-planned neighborhood in Dubai features a mix of modern villas, townhouses, and apartments, surrounded by lush green landscapes and amenities such as swimming pools, sports courts, and retail outlets.

Its strategic location near major roads and the Dubai Metro enhances connectivity, making it easy to access the wider city. Al Furjan's close-knit community atmosphere is further enriched by its nearby schools, leisure facilities, and various dining and shopping options, providing a comfortable and convenient living environment.

Public Transportation in Al Furjan

Public transportation in Al Furjan is well-developed and provides residents with convenient options to navigate around Dubai. The community is served by Route 2020 of the Dubai Metro, which includes the Al Furjan station, enhancing the connectivity of the area to major business, leisure, and retail hubs. Additionally, several bus routes connect Al Furjan to other parts of the city, ensuring that residents without private vehicles can also travel easily. For those preferring more personalized transport options, there are always taxis and a variety of ride-hailing services available, making transportation in and around Al Furjan accessible and efficient.

Supermarkets in Al Furjan

Al Furjan is well-equipped with a variety of supermarkets that cater to the daily needs of its residents, offering convenience and a wide range of products. Prominent supermarkets in the area include Spinneys and Carrefour, both of which are known for their quality groceries and variety of international products.

Additionally, there's a West Zone Fresh Supermarket, providing a selection of fresh produce, meats, and household items. For those looking for more specialized items, the community also hosts smaller groceries like Allday Fresh Supermarket and F Mart, which stock an assortment of everyday essentials along with ethnic foods that cater to the diverse population of Al Furjan.

Shopping Malls Near Al Furjan

Al Furjan is surrounded by a variety of amenities that cater to the needs of its residents. For shopping and entertainment, several malls are nearby, including the culturally themed Ibn Battuta Mall, just about 10 minutes away, and the smaller but convenient Discovery Pavilion, roughly 5 minutes from Al Furjan.

The Pavilion at Jumeirah Park is another nearby option, approximately 10 minutes away, featuring supermarkets, dining venues, and fitness facilities. Festival Plaza is also located nearby, a popular mall in Dubai that houses various retail stores, including IKEA.

Schools and Nurseries in Al Furjan

Educational needs are well-served by institutions such as the eco-friendly Arbor School and The Winchester School, both offering British curriculum education and located within about 15 15-minute' drive. Delhi Private School, located next to Winchester School, is an excellent option for those who want to enrol their kids in IB schools. For the youngest residents, Jebel Ali Village Nursery provides early childhood education right within the community, conveniently situated within a 5-minute drive.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Al Furjan

Religious facilities are also accessible within a reasonable driving distance. Al Furjan Mosque is located within the community, offering daily prayers and religious services for Muslim residents. St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church and the Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara are approximately 25 minutes away, serving the Catholic and Sikh communities, respectively. Additionally, the Shiva Temple and other Hindu worship places in the Bur Dubai area are about 45 minutes away.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Al Furjan

Residents of Al Furjan are well-served by a variety of medical facilities located conveniently nearby, ensuring access to comprehensive healthcare. The Mediclinic Ibn Battuta Mall, approximately 10 minutes away, offers a range of medical services as part of the renowned Mediclinic chain. For more extensive medical needs, the NMC Royal Hospital is about 15 15-minute drive, providing emergency care, specialty treatments, and outpatient services.

Closer still, the Aster Clinic in Discovery Gardens is just 5 minutes away, offering both general and specialist medical care within the Aster DM Healthcare network. Additionally, Lifeline Hospital in Jebel Ali, which is around a 20-minute drive, offers a broad spectrum of healthcare services, ensuring that residents have access to necessary medical care without significant travel.

Al Furjan Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Al Furjan is strategically situated in Dubai, offering excellent connectivity and easy access to the city's key locations. It lies near major roads such as Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, which facilitate quick travel to Dubai’s vibrant city center and other prominent areas.  Additionally, Al Furjan is conveniently close to Sports City, Jumeirah Golf Estates, and Dubai Investments Park, providing residents with easy access to these notable districts.
 

The community is also conveniently close to the Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo 2020 site, making it an ideal location for frequent travelers and business professionals. Nearby, residents can enjoy the extensive shopping, dining, and entertainment options available at Ibn Battuta Mall and the Discovery Pavilion. Additionally, Al Furjan’s proximity to the upcoming Route 2020 Metro line enhances its appeal by providing efficient public transportation options to and from the area. This prime location ensures that Al Furjan is well-poised as a dynamic and connected community, perfect for modern living in Dubai.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Al Furjan

data.answer:
Al Furjan offers a plethora of activities to engage its residents, from strolls along its landscaped walkways and family picnics in its community parks to invigorating workouts at the local health and wellness complexes.

Al Furjan Restaurants & Bars

Al Furjan is home to a selection of restaurants and bars that cater to a variety of tastes and dining preferences. Local favorites include eateries within the Al Furjan Club, where residents can enjoy meals in a lively, family-friendly setting. For a more diverse dining experience, the nearby Ibn Battuta Mall provides a range of international cuisines, from Italian and Indian to Arabic and Asian. These include Shakespeare and Co., India Palace, PizzaExpress, Nando's, and The Cheesecake Factory.

Near Al Furjan, you can also find a couple of bars that are popular for their ambiance and offerings. McGettigan's JLT is located approximately 15 minutes away by car, in the Jumeirah Lakes Towers area. This Irish pub is known for its lively atmosphere, extensive beverage menu, and regular live music and sports screenings.

Lock, Stock & Barrel JBR is about a 20-minute drive from Al Furjan, located in Jumeirah Beach Residence. This bar is a favorite for its vibrant nightlife scene, live entertainment, and creative cocktails, making it a popular spot for both tourists and locals.

Beaches Near Al Furjan

Al Furjan residents can enjoy several beautiful beaches within a short driving distance, perfect for a day out by the sea. Jumeirah Beach, a popular sandy stretch with a range of activities and amenities, is about 20 minutes away.

Slightly closer, the beaches around Dubai Marina, known for their lively atmosphere and waterfront dining, are approximately 15 minutes drive from Al Furjan. Additionally, the quieter and more serene Jebel Ali Beach is also around 20 minutes away, offering a more relaxed beach experience.

Hotels in and Near Al Furjan

Ecos Dubai Hotel and The Manor by JA are the two popular hotels in Al Furjan. Moreover, Al Furjan is close to a variety of hotels catering to different preferences and budgets. Within the community itself, there are several options, such as the Premier Inn Dubai Ibn Battuta Mall Hotel, conveniently located about 10 minutes away. It offers comfortable and budget-friendly accommodation with easy access to shopping and dining.

For more luxurious stays, the five-star Bonnington Jumeirah Lakes Towers and Movenpick Hotel Jumeirah Lakes Towers are both about 15 minutes drive, providing upscale facilities and dining options.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Al Furjan

Al Furjan is surrounded by numerous attractions and landmarks, making it an exciting place to live. The iconic Ibn Battuta Mall, just 10 minutes away, is not only a shopping destination but also a cultural site with six courts designed to reflect the regions that the explorer Ibn Battuta visited.  JA Shooting Club is also located in proximity to the area.

About 20-minute drive, Expo City Dubai offers interactive exhibits, futuristic architecture, and cultural events. Additionally, the world-renowned Palm Jumeirah, about 25-minute drive, provides a plethora of entertainment, dining, and leisure activities with stunning views of the Dubai skyline.

Traffic congestion can be a common challenge in growing residential areas like Al Furjan, especially during peak hours. As the community continues to develop and attract more residents, the influx of vehicles can lead to increased traffic on the main access roads, particularly near entrances and exits to the community, and around major intersections.

To help mitigate traffic issues, residents of Al Furjan can make use of alternative travel times, avoiding peak traffic hours typically in the morning and late afternoon.

What types of properties are available in Al Furjan?

Al Furjan offers a diverse range of properties including apartments, townhouses, and villas. These are available in various configurations, such as 2, 3, 4, and 5-bedroom units, catering to families of different sizes and preferences. Moreover, there are also various off plan properties in Al Furjan to invest in.

What amenities are available within Al Furjan?

Al Furjan provides a wealth of amenities for residents, including community centers, swimming pools, fitness centers, children's play areas, and landscaped parks. Additionally, the area has retail outlets, cafes, and restaurants to enhance the living experience.

How is the transportation connectivity in Al Furjan?

Al Furjan is well-connected by major roads such as Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It also benefits from proximity to the Ibn Battuta Metro station and several bus routes, making it easy for residents to travel to and from the area.

What are the nearby educational facilities in Al Furjan?

There are several reputable educational institutions near Al Furjan, including the Arbor School, The Winchester School, and Jebel Ali Village Nursery. These schools offer various curricula, providing quality education options close to home.

How to Get to Al Furjan Dubai by Bus or Metro?

To get to Al Furjan, Dubai, by public transport, take the Dubai Metro Red Line to the Al Furjan Metro Station. Alternatively, use the RTA bus routes F43 from Ibn Battuta Metro Station or F46 from Danube Metro Station, both of which serve the Al Furjan area. Ensure you have a Nol card for travel, and you can either walk or take a short taxi ride from the station or bus stop to your specific destination in Al Furjan.

nodes.title: Azizi Star
nodes.about:
Azizi Star is a 12-storey building in the Al Furjan neighborhood by the renowned developer Azizi. The project offers studios and 1-2 bedroom apartments with panoramic views of Jumeirah Lake Towers and Dubai Marina. This impressive development offers fully serviced and furnished apartments. Residents can enjoy open and spacious living spaces with futuristic and trendy designs, ideally designed for family living.

The complex offers a wide range of lifestyle and recreational amenities including a fitness center, gym, adult and children's pool, retail stores and cafes, recreation areas and game rooms. The complex has 24-hour video surveillance, parking, security and concierge.

The project is located next to the road Jebel Ali-Al Hibab, which can be used to reach the city center. The world's largest shopping center Dubai Mall or the famous Burj Khalifa Tower will take 27 minutes to reach.

The Arbor School, Al Adil Supermarket and Al Barakah Grocery are within walking distance of Azizi Star. The nearest nursery is Blossom Marina Nursery Dubai, a 14-minute drive away. It is located right by the Persian Gulf. Aster Hospital is a 7-minute drive away. And a 9-minute drive takes you to Ibn Battuta Mall with stores for clothing, household items, furniture, and children's products.
